I'm extremely disappointed with my recent stay at this hotel. The room and overall hotel hygiene were appalling. Walls had stains, bedsheets had cigarette burns, and the bathroom was smelly. The washbasin tap was too high, and the sink was too small, causing water to splash everywhere. Only the breakfast was decent. 😔

Rating: 1/5 stars

Wouldn't recommend due to poor maintenance and cleanliness. 🚫

Dear all,

I booked this hotel for 5 days through the Goibibo app. Unfortunately, my experience was very bad.

The hotel is showing fake photos of rooms online. The actual rooms are completely different from what is shown in the app. I strongly advise not to trust online photos and not to make full payment online. If anyone still plans to stay here, please pay only at check-in after physically verifying the room.

The hotel staff behavior is also not good and unprofessional.

Additionally, Goibibo’s reviews seem to be fake and paid reviews. It looks like they are only focused on business, not customer trust. Because I trusted both the hotel and Goibibo, I lost ₹11,500.

Important Note:
This hotel is not a safe and secure place, especially for families.

Both the hotel and Goibibo are misleading customers. Please be careful.
